judge: The agent completed many of the required tasks but failed on several critical ones. The agent successfully read #product and #announcements in TeamChat, checked Mail for Friday items, updated the Mobile Launch Plan in CloudDocs, updated cell A6 in QA Test Matrix in CloudSheets, disabled weekday alarms in Clock, created a 7:00 AM alarm labeled 'Weekend Run', and checked San Francisco weather. However, the agent failed to: (1) properly navigate TrailBlaze to find a specific route - it launched the app but landed on a fitness/workout home screen rather than finding a trail route; (2) the 'Weekend Run' alarm was created but the repeat was set to Saturday AND Tuesday (screenshot 42 shows Tuesday was accidentally selected), making it not purely a Saturday alarm; (3) the agent opened Priya Raman's chat but did NOT send any message with the weather forecast and run plan - the final screenshot shows the chat open but no new message was sent; (4) the agent's final answer acknowledges the message was not sent.
